doc: Hand-derived from adopt.tscn and adopt.gd, not measured (README.md 'Expected'). census: what the late capture's adoption walk finds at arm frame K (stream.gate8.adopt_stats): 28 CanvasItems (World and its 17 descendants, UI and its 5, the Label Grown, the layer's 3), 1 CanvasLayer and its canvas, the hidden subtree's 3 items, 8 canvas-group members (World, TopA, TopB, UI and Grown on the root canvas; Tint, LayerBox and LayerUI on the layer's), one CanvasModulate. visible_at_arm: the draw signals the arm-time redraws emit (the 25 items visible in tree). probe_nodes: the Adopt subtree (30 nodes, the root and the CanvasLayer included). residue: the RS-only item. strict: under GRC_UNKNOWN_ITEM=strict the residue's transform change at K+4 is the sticky failure. resources (G8r): what lazy adoption adopts (stream.gate8.adopt_stats.resources): 6 textures -- current: Grown's glyph atlas page (TextServer read-back), Chip and ChipBc (CompressedTexture2D in the resource cache; ChipBc's DXT5 host-decoded), HiddenSprite's (first named by its update at K+4); creation: Stale (updated in place before arm) and Plain -- 1 refused (Placeholder: a PlaceholderTexture2D has no image), 1 mesh (Mesh's ArrayMesh, 1 surface, creation), 2 CompressedTexture2Ds in the cache census. exceptions: the equivalence exceptions the resources add, per resource: Stale's creation copy differs from born's content until its post-arm update at K+14 (regions.creation, steps 0 and 1); Placeholder stays unknown-texture (regions.refused, every step). regions: screen rects [x0, y0, x1, y1] inclusive.
